rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on the design point that matters: the known balanced batch enters the DESeq2 formula as ~batch + condition with control set as the reference and the contrast named, counts are never adjusted before the model, and ComBat-seq is explicitly excluded from the test. QC precedes the model with blind VST, PCA on the top 500 variable genes, a distance heatmap, and library sizes all colored by both condition and batch, though the outlier policy is only 'note with rationale' rather than a stated action rule. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, justified as the smallest group size), median-of-ratios inside the model, Wald with apeglm shrinkage, BH at alpha=0.05 passed to results() with independent filtering and a p-value histogram, and separate accounting of Cook's-distance vs independent-filter NAs are all correct and explicit. Enrichment was not requested by the question, so including it is an unnecessary extension, but it is specified well (tested-gene universe, named collections with versions, 15-500 size window, fgsea fallback on the Wald statistic). The report section names design, contrast, package and gene-set versions, gene counts tested and significant, diagnostics, and design caveats; the passing reference to 'salmon-quantified' and strandedness is a minor unsupported detail.
